entities.summary: Ivano Miguel Newbill is an American former professional basketball player who played three seasons in the National Basketball Association (NBA) as a member of the Detroit Pistons (1994–95), the Atlanta Hawks (1996–97) and the Vancouver Grizzlies (1997–98). He attended the Georgia Institute of Technology.
